To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the smallest representation of any time granularity is the automaton that accepts the language of its granules and that the most tractable one is the one whose states are the maximal sets of granules that can be accepted by the automaton.

(1) there is an algorithm to compute the most tractable automaton for any time granularity in time O(|G|3); (2) this algorithm is optimal in terms of time complexity; and (3) there are time granularities for which the most tractable representations are exponentially smaller than their minimal representations.
(a) the most compact representation of a time granularities is not necessarily the most tractable one and that (b) there is no unique most tractable representation for a time granularity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and the study of compact, effective and tractable automata-based representations of time granularity.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the automaton-based approach provides a neat and effective solution to a wide range of fundamental algorithmic problems concerning time granularities and that it is the only approach to date that can deal with infinite granularities in a tractable way.
automata-based representations of time granularity are compact, efficient, and effective.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, by means of automaton-based representations, we can deal with time granularities of infinite size, and, in addition, we can compute compact and tractable representations for them.

, in the automaton-based approach to time granularities we have developed, the most compact and tractable representation of a given time granularity is obtained by computing the automaton that recognizes the language of all its granules.

we have developed a new and compact automaton-based representation for time granularities and we have provided an efficient and effective way for computing the smallest and most tractable representation for them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the automaton-based approach to time granularity, the problem of finding the most tractable automaton representation of a granularity turns out to be a problem of automata minimization.
tractability is a fundamental property of a representation, which should be taken into account when choosing one representation over another.

tractability and compactness are two orthogonal notions and that, as a matter of fact, the tractability of an automaton-based representation can be achieved without any loss of compactness, and vice versa.
